I did not build this case. This OpenFlowsheet version can't represent it, and I didn't substitute other units.

- **Adsorber (A101, A102):** none of the available models is an adsorber with a loaded-sorbent outlet. The catalogue has only mixers, splitters, component separators, conversion and kinetic reactors, heaters, flashes, pumps, valves, feeds and sinks. A component separator or conversion reactor would not do what a ZnO H2S bed does, so using one would be a substitute.
- **ThermalRegenerator (RG101):** no model regenerates loaded sorbent thermally, and no regeneration-fraction or restored-capacity model exists.
- **Property package `process_extension` / `native_pyomo_conservation_model`:** it has Liq, Vap and Sol phases for CH4, H2S, ZnO and ZnS. This version has no solid-sorbent property route. The case's `idaes_property_packages` list is empty, and the models expose no solid-phase or sorbent-loading properties. I did not find a way to list components, so I did not check whether ZnO and ZnS exist as components.
- **Specified values:** `bed_utilization_fraction` and `regeneration_fraction` are decision values for a reduced model. The response metrics (contaminant removal, restored capacity, product slip, sorbent waste index) are not specification targets this version can pin. The only targets it offers are stream flows, T, P, and unit duty.

The Feed, Separator (as `c1.stream_splitter`) and Product units do have equivalents. The two adsorbers and the regenerator are what the case can't be built without.

I committed no revision and submitted no solve job.

It also has no solid-sorbent (Sol phase) property route for the native_pyomo_conservation_model package with ZnO/ZnS. The reduced-model decision and response values (bed utilization, regeneration fraction, restored capacity and so on) cannot be expressed as this version's specification targets. Substituting separators or reactors would change what the units do, so nothing was built."}, "claims": []}
